resources.basis: Complete 75,188-case bank, all 1,052,632 original endpoint occurrences, 12 signed/unsigned entity operators plus a separate family contrast intercept, and ten fixed numerical benchmarks across all five rank301 working trees. Largest full component has 2,884 rows, 66,540,448 bytes per dense component; all squared blocks total 191,079,776 bytes. Dense seven-kernel component scratch at most 465,783,136 bytes; expanded species factor 181,052,704 bytes; maximum latent-factor projection 235,382,000 bytes. Full raw/source proof dictionaries dominate remaining memory. Reader assembles local bases by explicit sparse latent outer products, never a full observation covariance or a dense n-by-all-global-entity matrix. This is a fixed full-case numerical benchmark and operator/Gram bank, not optimizer fitting or a biological pilot; run measurements will inform separate fit resource estimates.

scope: Complete full 75,188-case shared-entity operator bank from the closed expanded covariance source, preserving all1,052,632 raw occurrences, distinct genes despite shared physical predictions and all full case/family/component/species-pattern identities. Export all six endpoint/entity kinds under signed and unsigned loadings plus a separately defined family contrast intercept:13 sparse operators. Exact signed family cancellation is preserved; unsigned family loadings are twice the family-intercept incidence and therefore their covariance kernels are proportional, not separately identified variance components. Complete full-case Frobenius kernel Grams on residual identity, six entity bases, family contrast intercept and species covariance across all five working trees diagnose zero/collinear bases; Gram conditioning squares basis conditioning and cohort-specific variance identifiability remains unqualified. Ten complete fixed-parameter numerical benchmarks evaluate block Cholesky and species Woodbury solves/log determinants on every original case, checked independently by raw Counter loadings, latent-space Gram identities and explicit latent outer products with block/species LU. Numerical refinement checks residuals without jitter, eigenvalue clipping, changed covariance targets or dropped cases. Full producer/reader/source/artifact/two-original-journal closure gates bank acceptance. Benchmarks are neither estimated variance components nor accepted shared-ancestry correction, biological effects, optimizer qualification or calibrated inference. Expanded fixed-design/cohort inventories and fit-resource specification remain separate; final signed/unsigned covariance/weight/control variants, prediction/domain/PAE/ascertainment, accepted species/reconciled gene trees, calibration and all eight scientific aims remain open. No GPU or new charges.
